I've played discipline priest since launch, and here's what I would change about them:

Bring back: - Divine Spirit - Mana Burn - Mind Soothe - Mind Control for everyone, not just those who pick the talent - Reflective shield on all targets - Power Infusion on all targets, with a bonus on damage for classes without mana

I always thought it was silly that priests could dispel magic, but not curses. I mean, from a flavor standpoint, isn't that what priests do?

I would also add more buffs. I loved how vanilla discipline priests weren't the best healers or damage dealers, but made EVERYONE better by their presence alone. I used to go around buffing even guards with Power Word: Fortitude, just to give them a tiny edge against interlopers.
